mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the Alloy solver to invent permission matrices where non-auditors can access the audit endpoint or non-officers can patch status, which the permission completeness and least-privilege assertions catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionMatrixViolation { Applicant -> GetAudit in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows two audit entries for the same application to have identical timestamps, violating the immutability and uniqueness property that the AppendOnly assertion enforces.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.application = ae2.application and ae1.occurred_at = ae2.occurred_at }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows audit entries to be created without required fields (actor, timestamp, new_status, reason) or with previous_status/new_status mismatches, which the audit-completeness assertion is designed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditFieldsViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.actor = none or ae.occurred_at = none or ae.new_status = none or ae.reason = none }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an applicant to have multiple in-flight applications simultaneously, violating the one-in-flight-per-applicant constraint from FR-008.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InFlightViolation { some u: User | #{la: LoanApplication | la.applicant = u and (la.status = Pending or la.status = UnderReview)} > 1 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an officer to be assigned to an application where they are also the applicant, violating the self-approval defense-in-depth check.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfApprovalViolation { some la: LoanApplication | la.assigned_officer = la.applicant and la.assigned_officer != none }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows illegal status transitions (e.g., Pending → Approved, or transitions out of terminal states), which the status-transition assertion is designed to prevent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_StatusTransitionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | (ae.previous_status = Pending and ae.new_status = Approved) or (ae.previous_status = Approved and ae.new_status != Approved) }
